overview.summary: Replaces the category tabs in the review list with a per-reviewer filter. The filter lives in the shared UI store, so the list, the tab counts and keyboard navigation all respect it.
risks: Any code that selects a finding programmatically must account for hidden reviewers.

flows.title: Hide a reviewer's findings
flows.description: The user unchecks a reviewer; the list, counts and selection update.
flows.trigger: Click on a checkbox in the Reviewers popover

nodes.label: App.vue → Reviewers button
nodes.summary: Opens the popover; shows `visible/total` when something is hidden.
nodes.changeSummary: New button replacing the All / Issues / Quality tabs.

nodes.label: toggleReviewer(name)
nodes.summary: Adds or removes the reviewer from `store.hiddenReviewers`.

nodes.label: store.hiddenReviewers
nodes.summary: Reactive list of hidden reviewer names.

nodes.label: matchesTab / hidden
nodes.summary: A finding is hidden when all of its reviewers are hidden.
nodes.changeSummary: Category filter replaced with the reviewer check.

nodes.label: watch(visible)
nodes.summary: Moves the selection to the first visible finding when the current one disappears.
nodes.changeSummary: Now watches `visible` instead of the tab and kind.

flows.title: Open a finding from the map
flows.description: Clicking a finding badge on a map node switches to the review tab and selects it.
flows.trigger: Click on a finding in the map node panel

nodes.label: MapNodePanel → finding link
nodes.summary: Lists findings linked to the node.

nodes.label: showFinding(id)
nodes.summary: Switches view and tab, then selects the finding.
nodes.changeSummary: No longer resets the category filter; doesn't touch the reviewer filter.

nodes.label: watch(visible)
nodes.summary: Can override the selection if the finding is hidden.
